settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 2–3 weeks. You'll get a tracking number by email when your order ships.

settings.question: What if something isn't right?
settings.answer: Email support@luxedealers.com with your order number and photos. We'll refund or reship it, with no need to send it back.

settings.question: Do you ship to my country?
settings.answer: We ship internationally, and shipping is free on every order. Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by the customer.
